newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: BWT sees 97 group sales rising over 7 pct.
newsitem.headline: BWT sees 97 group sales rising over 7 pct.

text.p: BWT AG, Europe's leading manufacturer of water treatment technology, said on Tuesday it expected to post higher group sales this year of 2.5 billion schillings after 2.32 billion in 1996.

Earnings would be weighed down by a charge of 60 million schillings necessary for marketing and investing in production of its new water treatment technology called "AQA total", BWT said in a statement.
BWT gave no further details for the 1997 earnings outlook, but said for 1998 it expects "AQA total" to bring in sales of 200 million schillings and to contribute 56 million schillings to earnings.
